review.body_prefix: Thanks for hardening the Mouse Without Borders Settings IPC path. Three localized fixes are included as inline suggestions below; the accepted-only process verification cache is a separate multi-region companion note.

proposed_comments.title: Honor cached revocation when verifying the peer signer

confidence.rationale: The current RIGHT-side code explicitly sets X509RevocationMode.NoCheck. The converged fork replacement uses the offline cache, rejects known revocation, tolerates only offline or unknown revocation statuses, and passed the targeted 23-test Settings IPC security run.

proposed_comments.title: Back off rejected clients and throttle both retry log paths

confidence.rationale: The current added server loop immediately continues after rejection and logs every rejection and exception. The fork replacement adds cancellation-aware rejection backoff and independent 30-second throttles; targeted MWB IPC tests passed and the final review was clean.

proposed_comments.title: Cache only accepted peer verification results by process instance

confidence.rationale: NamedPipePeerVerification.TryVerifyPeerProcess lines 95-180 currently reaches MeetsSigningPolicy at line 173 on every accepted reconnect. The validated fork uses PID plus process creation time and identity inputs as the key, stores only accepted results, and removes rejected keys.

proposed_comments.body:
### Cache only accepted peer verification results by process instance

**Severity:** `medium`

`TryVerifyPeerProcess` performs the full executable and signer verification on every accepted reconnect (`NamedPipePeerVerification.cs`, current lines 95–180, including `MeetsSigningPolicy` at line 173). Please cache successful verification by PID plus process creation time and the expected identity inputs, while never retaining rejected results. This is a multi-region change (imports and static state, the verification flow, helpers, and key or result records), so it is intentionally a general companion note rather than a partial inline suggestion.

proposed_comments.title: Keep generated certificate fixtures inside issuer validity

confidence.rationale: The current RIGHT-side helpers independently evaluate UtcNow for issuer and child expiration, so the child can outlive its issuer by a fraction of a second. The fork derives each notAfter from the issuer and the targeted Settings IPC suite then passed 23 of 23 tests.
